description: This file defines the InstructionFileMetadataStrategy class, which implements a strategy for storing and retrieving encryption metadata envelopes as instruction files in Amazon S3. It provides methods for saving the envelope data to S3 and loading it back, using a specific suffix for instruction files.

classes.name: InstructionFileMetadataStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for storing and loading encryption metadata envelope information on Amazon S3 as instruction files, implementing MetadataStrategyInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with an S3 client and an optional suffix for instruction files.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores the MetadataEnvelope into an instruction file on S3 by uploading it with a specific suffix.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Retrieves the instruction file from S3, reads its JSON content, and constructs a MetadataEnvelope from it.
